brief: A private phone-to-PC camera utility with a premium, approachable identity for Windows and Android.
criteria: A clear 16px silhouette, one-colour reproduction and consistent native app icons.

concepts.name: Offset
concepts.idea: A rounded field opens into a distinctive C.
rationale: An offset counter gives the silhouette its signature.
Soft corners echo the native application controls.
A horizontal opening stays readable at small sizes.

recommendation: Offset is the selected Camber identity.
next_steps: Use the supplied native icons and lockups.
